text:
Rafi K.: 0.7.0 is out. Quick triage thread: we have two customer-facing regressions and several polish requests. Need to lock scope for a hotpatch vs schedule for 0.7.1.
Simone L.: Link to tracker: https://redwood.atlassian.example/ROAD-2219 (short repro + sample orgs).
Owen T.: Which two regressions are we calling P0?
Rafi K.: P0-A: chat streaming sometimes drops final tokens when networks retract mid-response (bad UX). P0-B: embeddings endpoint returns 504 on long inputs for 3 orgs.
Mira V.: UX impact: dropped tokens break threaded conversations. Strong prefer a hotpatch for streaming. Embeds sounds infra-level.
deploy-bot: Next deploy window: today 19:30 UTC. Patch branch: refs/heads/patch/0.7.1. Runbook: https://confluence.example/releases/0.7.1-runbook
Simone L.: Proposal: hotpatch streaming in the next window; embed timeout goes into 0.7.1 with a canary (5% for 1h). All non-blocking polish -> backlog.
Owen T.: I can implement a conservative retry/flush guard for streaming. Will add integration tests. ETA: 3h for PR.
Rafi K.: Acceptance criteria for hotpatch: synthetic suite shows zero dropped messages for 20m on canary orgs; no new customer reports in that window. For embeddings: 99.9% success in canary for 1h.
Mira V.: Small design ask: if we retry, preserve original event ordering. Not blocking the hotpatch unless it changes UX.
Simone L.: Owners: @Owen T. -> streaming guard + tests, @Mira V. -> UX sign-off, @Rafi K. -> customer comms + status page update. @Simone L. -> schedule 0.7.1 and slot embed work.
Owen T.: Branch steps:
```
git checkout -b patch/0.7.1-hotstream
# cherry-pick fix
git push origin patch/0.7.1-hotstream
```
Owen T.: Will open PR and request reviews. Canary steps in PR description.
Rafi K.: If hotpatch can't be ready for today's window we default to 0.7.1 plan. Escalate to on-call if rollback needed.
Simone L.: Noted. I'll update roadmap row and move backlog items to the grooming column.
deploy-bot: Deploy plan draft created: https://deploys.redwood.example/plans/DEP-2024-041 (contains rollback steps)
Mira V.: Great. Also flagging a medium bug (autocomplete delay) for 0.7.1 rather than backlog; impacts discoverability.
Rafi K.: Thanks team. I'll publish the status update after PR merges.
Owen T.: PR opened -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/789. Tagging SRE for canary monitoring.
Simone L.: Moving cards and assigning owners now. :white_check_mark:
